newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels to buy more luxury hotels.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels to buy more luxury hotels.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said Thursday that it has increased its borrowing capacity by $325 million, which it said it will use to buy more luxury hotels.
Interstate has acquired 18 hotels since its initial public offering in June 1996, and now has full or controlling interests in 32 upscale hotels.

Specifically, Interstate's term loan facility has expanded from $295 million to $430 million, its revolving credit facility has increased from $200 million to $350 million and its permitted non-recourse and subordinated debt capacity have increased from $250 million to $290 million.
The increase in the credit facility, said the company, was underwritten by the New York branch of Credit Lyonnais and syndicated to 40 banks.
The company did not specify which geographic regions it was looking at for acquisitions, saying only that they would look at "property strategically located in growing markets."
